name: Strong-open cascade on ETH (log scale, 1 pt = 1 bp, 10 bp cost)
why: The US cash open brings the same institutional order flow into crypto (ETF creations, US desks starting their day); the cascade's 'follow the morning move' should carry if that flow is real there too. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_owned_data_ideas.md).
